section_2_text_1: Certified translations of official documents – quick and easy
section_2_text_2: Do you need a certified translation of official documents and want to make the process as easy and quick as possible? Then you've come to the right place! section_3_title: Simple and quick processing of your certified translations
section_3_p_1: Upload your document in just a few seconds.

section_3_text_4: Shipping by post to your home
section_3_p_4: The certified translation will be sent directly from the translator to your home by post.
